StarPersonaStarPersona

Fingerprint browser · Account environments

Planning

A planned open-source fingerprint browser and multi-account environment manager, with a public repository established.

The repository currently contains only a README and MIT license. The name and direction are established, but core development has not started. This page describes planned scope.

Project planningMIT

Current status: Only the project description and license are available; core code and installable versions have not been provided yet.

Planned scope

  • Planned: fingerprint browser
  • Planned: multi-account environment management
  • Target platforms: Windows and macOS; implementation and verification are pending

Platforms and distribution

Windows and macOS are planned; neither platform has an installable version yet.

Source and progress

Follow the public repository for progress. Independent installers and official releases will be announced by the project.
